jordan: Quick heads-up: customers reporting intermittent 503s from embeddings in eu-west since ~2026-04-01T07:08Z. Currently marking as investigating. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1822224444

leah: Seeing elevated client retries and long tail p99 for batched embed requests. Impact mostly on batch_size>64 jobs.

marco-sre: Early triage: one storage node hit file-descriptor exhaustion from a noisy long-running query (third-party crawler job) causing connection churn to local embed shards. Repro: fd count > 65k, accept() failures -> 503s. Taking node out of rotation.

ops-bot: Log excerpt:
2026-04-01T07:10:02Z ERROR embed-reader accept: too many open files
2026-04-01T07:10:04Z WARN  metric 5xx_rate=0.21 endpoint=/v1/embeddings region=eu-west
2026-04-01T07:11:20Z INFO  node-manager draining node=es-node-17

jordan: Mitigations applied:
- Drained and reprovisioned problematic storage node (es-node-17)
- Applied immediate ulimit bump on embed readers to 200k fds where safe
- Implemented temporary admission control: cap batch_size to 48 for eu-west
- Routing: migrated a small portion of heavy customers to eu-central read replica (CS notified)
Observed: 5xx rate dropped from ~21% -> ~6% in last 9 minutes, tail latency improving.

leah: CS outreach: creating short blurb and opening #cs-embeddings-eu-temp. Offering quick opt-in to eu-central for customers that need immediate stability.

marco-sre: Next steps:
1) validate fd leak is resolved and monitor open_fds across fleet (watch threshold 75k)
2) run scan for similar long-running crawler jobs and throttle/ban if necessary
3) plan postmortem and permanent fix (auto-uplift of ulimits + better admission control)
If we see regression we'll failover embeddings traffic for eu-west to eu-central entirely.

deploy-bot: Suspended non-critical eu-west deploys for 45m to reduce churn.

status-bot: Severity set to Sev2. Incident bridge: https://call.redwood.ai/bridge/1822224444 (ops on bridge).

jordan: Please claim postmortem in #postmortems; I'll lead. Will post another update after fd counts normalize or sooner on regression.

leah: Will draft exec one-liner if we stabilize in 30m. Thanks all.
